We focus our energy and talent at the intersection of Enterprise 5.0 companies and cross border innovation.

## Human Capital

We designed BGV to go beyond the financing of portfolio investments and provide high value human capital expertise needed to help entrepreneurs build global B2B technology companies.

[Learn More](https://benhamouglobalventures.com/human-capital/)

## Cross Border

We are immigrant entrepreneurs-turned-venture-capitalists ourselves. We speak your language, we know your culture, and we’re well equipped with global resources and cross-border advisors to help you chart your journey.

[Learn More](https://benhamouglobalventures.com/cross-border-portfolio/)

## Enterprise 5.0

We invest in startups that are making leapfrog shifts in enterprise automation, driving massive productivity improvements by combining intelligent machines with human ingenuity, while grounded in responsible, human-centric design.

[Learn More](https://benhamouglobalventures.com/enterprise-5-0/)

##### For enterprises to adopt AI at scale, measuring ROI is non-negotiable. AI isn’t just about cost savings - it’s about augmenting productivity, enhancing decision-making, and unlocking new revenue streams. Enterprise 5.0 requires AI-native startups to quantify these benefits upfront to accelerate adoption and build long-term trust.
